summary: Tested 3 new features: (1) Community threading/replies with likes — fully working end-to-end, (2) DailyPracticeWidget on /menu page (Sacred Practice of the Day) — working with moon phase, element, crystal, oracle, (3) Crystal deep profiles — 20 crystals including all 5 new ones confirmed. All 15 backend tests passed. All frontend UI flows verified via Playwright.

minor.issue: Dead/unreachable code block after add_community_reply function (lines 840-845). A docstring + query block with no function decorator — leftover from a refactor. Not causing any functional bug but should be cleaned up.

action_items: MINOR: Remove dead code at lines 840-845 in /app/backend/routers/content.py (unreachable code block after add_community_reply function)

NOTE: SacredPracticeWidget (data-testid='sacred-practice-widget') is in the authenticated /dashboard route — not directly accessible from 'Enter the Temple' button (which goes to /menu). The /menu page uses DailyPracticeWidget (data-testid='daily-practice-widget') instead. Both are working correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Dead code at content.py lines 840-845: string docstring + unreachable DB query block left after refactor. Not a runtime error but should be cleaned up.

Dashboard SacredPracticeWidget is only accessible when logged in (/dashboard ProtectedRoute). The public-facing 'Enter the Temple' button goes to /menu which uses the separate DailyPracticeWidget component. Both are correctly implemented and working.
Community posts list at /community shows all posts including TEST_ data from automated tests — consider adding a test data cleanup mechanism or limiting test data creation.

success_rate.frontend: 100% - All flows verified: landing page, community page, post modal, like/reply, DailyPracticeWidget on /menu

test_credentials: No login required for Community or /menu. SacredPracticeWidget at /dashboard requires auth.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests created TEST_ prefixed community posts for testing. These are now visible in the community list (10 posts). Not cleaned up after tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Community page at /community now has 10+ TEST_ posts from automated tests. All community features working: like button on card and in modal increments count, toggle-replies expands replies section, reply form submits and appends reply in real-time with success toast. Crystal deep profile endpoint returns 20 crystals (15 original + 5 new: lepidolite, rhodonite, fluorite, chrysocolla, sunstone). /api/daily-practice endpoint returns moon_phase, day_theme, morning_practice, evening_practice correctly. DailyPracticeWidget on /menu (data-testid='daily-practice-widget') shows moon phase (client-side calc), element of day (data-testid='element-of-day'), crystal (data-testid='crystal-of-day'), oracle message (data-testid='oracle-message'). SacredPracticeWidget in Dashboard.jsx (data-testid='sacred-practice-widget') is at protected /dashboard route.
